articles.title: New NetScaler Zero-Day Exploited in Targeted Attacks Can Knock SAML Deployments Offline
articles.summary:
Citrix has released security updates for a high-severity security flaw in NetScaler ADC and Citrix NetScaler Gateway that has been exploited as part of targeted zero-day attacks.

The vulnerability, tracked as CVE-2026-88779, carries a CVSS score of 8.7 out of 10.0.

articles.title: GlassWorm Supply Chain Attack Hides Malware Inside VS Code Color Themes
articles.summary:

articles.title: Microsoft Releases Emergency Exchange Server Update to Fix CVE-2026-96940
articles.summary:
